user.title: Claude Code Terminal Setup
user.description: Enter your Anthropic API key to enable Claude Code Terminal. This key will be stored securely and used to authenticate Claude Code CLI sessions.

data_description.api_key: Your Anthropic API key (starts with 'sk-ant-'). Get one at https://console.anthropic.com/
data_description.working_dir: The default directory where Claude Code will operate (must be within allowed directories)

error.invalid_api_key: The API key format is invalid. It should start with 'sk-ant-'.
error.invalid_working_dir: The working directory is not allowed for security reasons. Choose from: /config, /share, /addon_configs, /homeassistant
error.claude_not_found: Claude Code CLI was not found on the system. Please install it first: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
error.auth_failed: Failed to authenticate with the provided API key. Please verify it's correct.

abort.already_configured: Claude Code Terminal is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.
